get.summary: List triggers for the authenticated organization.
get.description:
Returns a paginated list of triggers. Supports filtering, sorting, and optional scope-based lookups via the machine or folder parameters.
            
When include=perMachine is specified, the response data array changes shape: instead of trigger items it returns
per-machine groups. The machine or folder parameter is required in that case.
            
Error codes returned in the errorCode field: scope_params_conflict (both machine and folder specified),
scope_params_required (include token requires scope), machine_not_found (404), folder_not_found (404),
scope_resolution_too_broad (folder resolved too many machines, also includes resolvedCount and limit),
scope_params_invalid (malformed scope input).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Gets or sets the page number for pagination (1-based).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Gets or sets the number of items per page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Gets or sets the field to sort results by.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Gets or sets the sort direction.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Gets or sets a filter by enabled status. Omit to return both enabled and disabled triggers.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Gets or sets a filter by trigger type.

parameters.name: entityType
parameters.description: Gets or sets a filter by entity type (e.g. Computers, Sessions).

parameters.name: isCommon
parameters.description: Gets or sets a filter by whether the trigger is a built-in (common) trigger. Set to false to return only custom triggers.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Gets or sets a filter by name. Filter triggers whose name contains the given string. Case-insensitive. Maximum 200 characters.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Gets or sets optional expansions. 'scope' adds scopeSummary (included/excluded counts) to each trigger item. 'summary' adds top-level aggregate counts by type, enabled status, and common/custom. Can be combined: include=scope&include=summary or include=scope,summary.

parameters.name: machine
parameters.description: Gets or sets a filter by machine FQDN or hostname. Cannot be combined with 'folder'. Required when using scopeMatch, resolvedMachines, or perMachine includes. Maximum 512 characters.

parameters.name: folder
parameters.description: Gets or sets a filter by folder path. Cannot be combined with 'machine'. Maximum 1024 characters.

get.summary: Get full details for a single trigger.

parameters.name: triggerId
parameters.description: Trigger GUID.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of sections to include: actions, scope, filter, schedule, typeSettings. Omit or leave empty to include all.

404.description: Trigger not found in the caller's organization.

422.description: One or more unknown include keys.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-based).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results per page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort direction (asc or desc).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Filter by name.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Filter by source.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Optional sections to include (e.g. summary).

parameters.name: scheduleId
parameters.description: Schedule ID or built-in name.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Optional sections to include (e.g. usage).

parameters.name: usageLimit
parameters.description: Maximum number of usage entries to return.

data.description: Gets or sets the list of triggers matching the query.

errorCode.description: Gets or sets the machine-readable error code. Possible values: scope_params_conflict, scope_params_required, machine_not_found, folder_not_found, scope_resolution_too_broad, scope_params_invalid.

message.description: Gets or sets the human-readable error message.

resolvedCount.description: Gets or sets the number of machines resolved by the scope query. Present only for scope_resolution_too_broad errors.

limit.description: Gets or sets the maximum allowed number of resolved machines. Present only for scope_resolution_too_broad errors.

TriggerErrorResponseDto.description: Error response body returned by trigger endpoints.

id.description: Gets or sets the unique identifier of the folder.

name.description: Gets or sets the display name of the folder.

path.description: Gets or sets the full path of the folder.

V1ScopeFolderDto.description: Folder resolved from a scope query.

fqdn.description: Gets or sets the fully-qualified domain name of the machine.

hostname.description: Gets or sets the short hostname of the machine.

folderPath.description: Gets or sets the folder path where the machine resides.

V1ScopeMachineDto.description: Machine resolved from a scope query.

triggerId.description: Gets or sets the unique identifier of the trigger.

triggerName.description: Gets or sets the display name of the trigger.

description.description: Gets or sets the description of the trigger.

type.description: Gets or sets the human-readable trigger type (e.g. StressLevel, WindowsEvent, Scheduled).

internalType.description: Gets or sets the internal type name used by the ControlUp agent.

entityType.description: Gets or sets the type of entity this trigger monitors (e.g. Computers, Sessions).

enabled.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the trigger is currently enabled.

isCommon.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this is a built-in (common) trigger shared across organizations.

actionsCount.description: Gets or sets the number of actions attached to this trigger.

createdAt.description: Gets or sets the timestamp when the trigger was created.

updatedAt.description: Gets or sets the timestamp when the trigger was last updated.

matchedPath.description: Gets or sets the folder path that matched the trigger's scope rule.

machine.description: Gets or sets the FQDN of the machine that was matched.

V1TriggerScopeMatchDto.description: Scope match result for a trigger against a queried machine or folder.

includedCount.description: Gets or sets the number of entities explicitly included in the trigger scope.

excludedCount.description: Gets or sets the number of entities explicitly excluded from the trigger scope.

V1TriggerScopeSummaryDto.description: Summary of the trigger's scope configuration.

orgId.description: Gets or sets the organization identifier.

region.description: Gets or sets the region where the organization data is stored.

total.description: Gets or sets the total number of triggers matching the query across all pages.

limitPerPage.description: Gets or sets the number of items per page as requested via the limit parameter.

currentPageNumber.description: Gets or sets the current page number (1-based).

currentPageSize.description: Gets or sets the number of items returned on the current page.

remaining.description: Gets or sets the number of items remaining after the current page.

V1TriggersMetadataDto.description: Pagination and organizational metadata for a triggers list response.

kind.description: Gets or sets the scope kind. One of: machine, folder.

input.description: Gets or sets the raw input value used to resolve the scope (FQDN, hostname, or folder path).

resolvedMachines.description: Gets or sets the list of machines resolved from the scope. Present only when include=resolvedMachines is requested.

resolvedFolders.description: Gets or sets the list of folders resolved from the scope. Present only when include=resolvedFolders is requested.

V1TriggersScopeDto.description: Scope filter information applied to the triggers query.

enabled.description: Gets or sets the count of enabled triggers.

disabled.description: Gets or sets the count of disabled triggers.

common.description: Gets or sets the count of built-in (common) triggers.

custom.description: Gets or sets the count of custom (user-created) triggers.

byType.description: Gets or sets the count of triggers per type.

V1TriggersSummaryDto.description: Aggregate counts across all triggers matching the query filters (not limited to the current page).
